name: Unidirectional Importance Sampling for Double-Scattering
aliases: Joint importance sampling of low-order volumetric scattering (unidirectional)
definition: A fully analytic method to importance sample the geometry terms along 3-segment paths (double-scattering) in isotropic participating media, generalizing equiangular sampling for 2-segment paths.
summary: Unidirectional Importance Sampling for Double-Scattering is a fully analytic method that reduces variance in isotropic participating media by constructing a joint probability density function for double-scattering paths to cancel geometry term singularities.
